Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Runs 168–189 artist and release fields were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles, unselected alternates and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.
The scan covered current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue material. Nine exact-title leads survived without padding.

Ploy's current Glizzy EP, Loidis, Saint Abdullah & Eomac, Jennifer Loveless, Maxime Denuc and other already-recorded fields were inspected but excluded as persistent history. Same-day Da Productor, Antony Well and lilias releases were not padded into the request because available evidence did not establish candidate-specific structure.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 51-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
